selection: Only dev scores may select a variant. Prefer passing gate, then macro R@10, then MRR@10; baseline wins ties. No tuning after final inspection. Paid answer/judge stage and default promotion remain pending.
labels: Source-complete local AI review of union top10 across all variants plus prior positive candidates; missing/invalid reviews stay unknown and block scoring. Freeze common labels before scoring. Existing labels are contextual checks, never automatic negatives for new candidates.
final: 24 fresh AI-authored questions frozen before dev-score inspection; 12 English/12 Chinese on six source families not used in this new dev extension. Only one final chosen-variant checkpoint; synthetic/source-aware, not human blind gold.
